primary.description: Deep Slate/Navy for authority and structure

accent.description: Royal Blue for primary actions and trust

warning.description: Amber for alerts and pending actions

destructive.description: Red for errors and negative values

usage_rules.gradients: Minimal usage. Only for subtle active states or hero backgrounds. No full-screen gradients.
usage_rules.text_contrast: Always ensure WCAG AA compliance. Use slate-600 for secondary text, never lighter.
usage_rules.dashboard_data: Use semantic colors (green/red) sparingly. Most data should be neutral (slate-900) to reduce cognitive load.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Gap-6 or Gap-8 for grids.

grids.marketing: Tetris Grid: Asymmetrical, mixing large hero blocks with smaller detail squares.
grids.dashboard: Control Room Grid: Dense, 4-column layout. Widgets stretch to fill height.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-11 px-8 rounded-none font-bold uppercase tracking-wide transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-11 px-8 rounded-none font-semibold transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground h-11 px-8 rounded-none font-bold uppercase transition-all

cards.style: bg-card text-card-foreground border border-border shadow-none rounded-md hover:border-accent/50 transition-colors
cards.dashboard_widget: bg-white border border-slate-200 p-6 flex flex-col h-full

inputs.style: h-11 rounded-sm border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:border-transparent bg-white

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use 'shadow-sm' for depth. Avoid large, diffuse shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Crisp 1px borders are the primary separator. Use 'divide-y' and 'divide-x' utilities.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on dark backgrounds to prevent banding and add 'paper' feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use only for sticky headers: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/50.

motion.hover_effects: Subtle lift (-translate-y-0.5) for cards. Color shift for buttons.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders for data. No spinners for page loads.

hero_main.alt: Diverse finance team in modern office meeting

feature_accountant.alt: Professional accountant working on laptop with financial data

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px. Color: slate-600 (default) or accent (active).

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a high-trust, professional financial application. Precision is key. Do not use rounded, bubbly UI. Stick to the 'Swiss' aesthetic: clean lines, strong typography, and structured grids.
instructions_to_main_agent.landing_page: Use the 'Tetris Grid' layout. The hero section should be bold with the 'hero_main' image. Use 'Chivo' font for a massive headline. Emphasize the 'Secure' and 'CFO' aspects.
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard: Use the 'Control Room' grid. It must be dense but readable. Use 'Manrope' for all data tables and numbers. Ensure high contrast for text. Do not use card shadows; use borders.
instructions_to_main_agent.auth_pages: Split screen layout. Left side: Login form (clean, minimal). Right side: 'abstract_growth' image with a dark overlay and a testimonial quote.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Style them to match the palette (Slate, Blue, Emerald). Avoid rainbow colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA contrast. All inputs must have visible focus states (ring-2 ring-accent).

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text or buttons.
Do not center-align long text blocks.
